verdict.rationale: Firebase's own docs say the Authentication SDK provides methods for email/password sign-in, including password reset emails, and for Google, Facebook, Twitter and GitHub sign-in. FirebaseUI adds a drop-in UI that handles these flows, which supports quick setup, and a community comment says account management and libraries 'come for free.' missing for 10: independent hands-on evidence that setup really takes only minutes.

support.subject: As a developer, I can add email/password and social OAuth sign-in with the platform SDK in minutes

citations.quote: The Firebase Authentication SDK provides methods to create and manage users that use their email addresses and passwords to sign in.
The Firebase Authentication SDK provides methods that allow users to sign in with their Google, Facebook, Twitter, and GitHub accounts.

FirebaseUI provides a drop-in auth solution that handles the UI flows for signing in users with email addresses and passwords, phone numbers, and with popular federated identity providers, including Google Sign-In and Facebook Login.
